contract_decisions.temporal_production: Temporal Cloud default with multi-AZ and acknowledged-event RPO 0 requirement
contract_decisions.invocation_security: mTLS plus ES256 envelope, 60-second maximum lifetime and durable nonce check
contract_decisions.tool_retry: No automatic retry without external idempotency key, status query and compensation or manual recovery
contract_decisions.data_retention: Classified lifecycle policy with at least 24-hour hot stream retention

deferred_runtime_enforcement.rule: A command deadline must still be valid at durable acceptance and invocation
deferred_runtime_enforcement.reason: Audit and replay decoding must remain able to read an expired historical command

deferred_runtime_enforcement.rule: The same command ID with a different canonical hash is a conflict
deferred_runtime_enforcement.owner: Java command ledger/Python graph command ledger
deferred_runtime_enforcement.reason: Conflict detection requires durable prior state, not a stateless schema codec

deferred_runtime_enforcement.rule: Tenant, actor, room epoch, thread and capability bindings match current authority
deferred_runtime_enforcement.reason: Binding validation requires authenticated authority and nonce state
